prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Meridian Regional Air Traffic Flow Management and Airport Collaborative Decision-Making System = Regional Flow Platform (Cedarbell). Airports Meridian International, Harbor East, North Valley, Lakeside Regional, Southport keep safety authority. Elements: Demand Prediction Service (DPS, Marlinstone; AAR=Airport Acceptance Rate); Capacity Assessment Module (correlates capacity changes with Airport Capacity Plan/AAR); Slot Allocation Engine (Blueharbor; CTT=Calculated Takeoff Time); Departure Metering Service (DMS, Emberline); DPS/CAM/SAE/DMS reject data lacking trusted timestamp. Airport CDM Portal; Identity Access Service (IAS); Audit Event Ledger (AEL; logs access, config, exports, compliance events, time source, discrepancy dispositions); Time Synchronization Service (common time basis for freshness); Alert Distribution Hub (raises urgent discrepancies affecting metering/arrival regulation/slots, reviewed in Digital Briefing Room); Performance Analytics Warehouse (PAW; compliance aggregates, role-limited); Collaborative Decision Log (CDL); Business Rules Registry (BRR; validation thresholds, reason codes, exception rules per mode, compliance tolerances); Tower Sequence Manager, Ramp Movement Board (send movement milestones); Surface Surveillance Adapter (position quality checks, marks uncertain observations); Weather Ingest Gateway (weather classification inputs owned by Meteorology Briefing Officer); Flight Data Exchange (validates Flight Intent Message before use); Airline Interface Adapter (carrier format checks, common meaning); Handling Resource Planner (validates quantities/timing/allocation IDs); Common Situation Display (freshness indicators: last update, max age, current/aging/stale/unavailable); Contingency Operations Console; North/South Runway. Silverpine (alias, unspecified) SHALL accept emergency access only after IAS records incident reference/expiry. Airline Operations Coordinator accountable for schedule intent, readiness, TOBT (Target Off Block Time) updates; TOBT issued only if capacity allows, frozen at horizon; freeze changes need reason code visible to RFM. Validation: schema, mandatory, code set, temporal, plausibility. Discrepancy: mark disputed, keep prior value; Data Governance Steward (DGS) coordinates resolution with owner, maintains ownership register (meaning, range, authority, retention, escalation), verifies audit fields, post-reviews emergency access; System Support Engineer (SSE) investigates technical causes. Modes: Normal Operations; Adverse Weather Mode; Capacity Reduction State; Recovery Phase; Contingency Fallback State (Airport Duty Manager (ADM) declares after consulting Regional Flow Manager

New part:
S836: The Performance Analytics Warehouse shall retain data quality measures, including validation failure rates, freshness breaches, manual corrections, and recurring ownership conflicts.
S837: Stewardship reviews shall use those measures to update training, adjust validation rules, and improve the reliability of information used in operational decision making.
S838: Performance measurement for the Meridian Regional Air Traffic Flow Management and Airport Collaborative Decision-Making System shall convert operational events into repeatable indicators that can be reviewed after each operating day.
S839: The Performance Analytics Warehouse shall calculate delay absorption as the portion of expected airborne or terminal-area delay that is converted into controlled ground delay before departure.
S840: Delay absorption shall be measured by comparing the unconstrained demand predicted by the Demand Prediction Service with the regulated demand produced by the Slot Allocation Engine and the realized movement times captured through the Flight Data Exchange.
S841: The principal delay absorption indicator shall report minutes absorbed at origin, minutes remaining in the arrival stream, and minutes transferred to surface queues within the region.
S842: The Regional Flow Manager shall use this indicator to verify that a Ground Delay Program reduced airborne holding without creating excessive departure congestion at constrained airports.
S843: Queue length performance shall be measured for runway departure queues, arrival metering queues, apron movement queues, and regulation waiting lists.
S844: The Tower Sequence Manager shall provide runway sequence counts, while the Ramp Movement Board shall provide surface queue counts based on movement status and surveillance confirmation.
S845: The North Runway Meter, South Runway Meter, East Apron Sensor, and West Apron Sensor shall support independent checks of queue length where surveillance coverage is available.
S846: Queue metrics shall include maximum queue length, average queue length, time above threshold, and recovery time after a constraint is lifted.
S847: Slot adherence shall be measured as the difference between actual movement times and the assigned Calculated Takeoff Time or Target Off Block Time.
S848: The Slot Coordinator shall review slot adherence by operator, airport, time band, and regulation identifier to detect recurring causes of noncompliance.
S849: A flight shall be counted within tolerance when the actual takeoff or off-block event occurs inside the operating window defined in the Business Rules Registry.
S850: The Slot Compliance State shall be used to identify periods when adherence monitoring has operational priority over advisory optimization.
S851: The Departure Metering Service uses the Passenger Misconnect Count to weight departure sequencing decisions when connection protection is an approved local objective.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
